# NEXDECK

> App platform for the Guition ESP32-4848S040 (ESP32-S3, 480x480 RGB touch display, microSD) and NEXDECK HUB, its Windows companion app (C# 5, .NET Framework 4). The NEXLauncher installs apps from the SD card; apps use the SquareBoard Arduino library; apps that talk to the PC use a checksummed serial protocol and have a HUB module (the app's PC side).

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules and commands for AI coding agents
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): toolchain, flashing the launcher, first app, installing apps

## Reference
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): partitions (app0 launcher, app1 app), boot flow, HUB core and modules
- [Library](docs/library.md): sq:: board API, Canvas drawing, fonts, SquareLauncher.h, SquareLink.h
- [Protocol](docs/protocol.md): 460800 app dialect (lines + K/E, EV events, blocks, LS/FPUT/RM/OPENAPP), 921600 launcher dialect
- [HUB modules](docs/hub-modules.md): HubApp lifecycle, AppPage UI, components, utilities (QrCode, PhotoSource, Txt.Clean)
- [App packages](docs/app-package.md): .nexapp zip and .icn icon format
- [Design guide](docs/design-guide.md): slate palette, layout, touch, icons, loading states
- [Hardware](docs/hardware.md): pins and quirks
